description: Independently traced per period using native RGB and user-provided example screenshots; no intensity snapping. Coordinates in native pixels; visible segments only. Origin is first observed root cohort, separate from current temporal state.
notes: T1: every visible root is baseline; no newborn or persistence state assigned.
T2-T4: cohort and temporal state independent; persistence only for locally overlapping visible segments.
No image-intensity ridge snapping, no hidden-root interpolation.
